description: For a stay already booked with free cancellation: pass the confirmation email's text. The otter keeps five facts (property, dates, total paid, deadline, where it was booked), discards the rest (no names, confirmation numbers or card details), reads the property's rate every morning and emails the account when a cheaper rate it can still cancel into appears (5% or $50), with reminders 7, 3 and 1 days before the deadline. Hotels booked direct are read across sellers through Google's rate list. A single whole home has one calendar, so once booked its price can't drop for the traveler: the first read finds the nights taken, the otter emails to say so and offers (free) to watch other whole homes nearby for the same dates until the deadline. A watch that closes without a drop ends with one note saying the price held (the reads and the lowest rate seen); a drop alert asks whether the traveler rebooked, and the answers feed the public track record as totals. Needs a key; free and unlimited. The otter never books or cancels.

confirmation.description: The confirmation email's text, as the traveler pasted or forwarded it

paidUsd.description: What they paid in US dollars, when the confirmation is in a currency the otter can't convert

name: watch_booking
title: Watch a booking until its free-cancellation deadline
